excluded.LayoutRows:op/newrow: rows-v1 New Row has no resource-operations-v2 op (only cmux-tui's legacy new-row command, server.rs NewRow)
excluded.LayoutRows:op/torow: rows-v1 move tab to a new row has no resource-operations-v2 op
excluded.LayoutRows:op/pinrow: edge docks of layout-model.md (FRAME = TRUE) have no resource-operations-v2 op
excluded.LayoutRows:op/orient: the frame orientation of layout-model.md (FRAME = TRUE) has no resource-operations-v2 op
excluded.TabLayout:DropTearOff: a trace whose tear-off reaches the owner is dropped (op tearoff has no product op), and in 1,000 simulated traces of TabLayout_fixed.cfg none lost its tear-off before the owner applied it
excluded.TabLayout:DuplicateBatch: client channel only (the owner and so the daemon facet never see it), and TLC's random simulation took it in none of 1,000 traces of TabLayout_fixed.cfg: the one fault of MaxFaults = 1 goes to Disconnect, OwnerRestart or ReplayRequest first
excluded.TabLayout:op/split: SplitWithTab has no resource-operations-v2 op: pane.split always starts a new terminal in the new pane
excluded.TabLayout:op/tearoff: MoveToNewWorkspace (tear-off) has no resource-operations-v2 op: workspace.create starts its own terminal or none
excluded.closefocus:view: #26009: no product checks the focus after a close yet; the app variant of these cases (action.run steps on named panes, checked against focusedPane) is the follow-up
excluded.OwnershipConvergence:op/move-to-empty-pa: the model keeps an emptied pane and moves a tab into it; the daemon has no empty pane to name (an emptied pane is removed in the same commit), and moving a tab into a new pane has no resource-operations-v2 op
excluded.OwnershipConvergence:op/write: a client-owned record write needs the writer's connection identity; the case driver has one connection (a second identified connection is p15-oracle-237's user connection)
excluded.FeedHandoff:LocalAnswer: the user answers the item at the local feed server (a daemon feed command, not a resource-operations-v2 op)
excluded.FeedHandoff:StartHandoff: the local server freezes the item and sends feed.adopt to FeedDO, which the offline oracle has none of
excluded.FeedHandoff:Resend: the local server resends feed.adopt with key adopt:<id> to FeedDO
excluded.FeedHandoff:LocalMoved: the local server records moved after FeedDO's result
excluded.FeedHandoff:TimeoutUnfreeze: the handoff is between the daemon's local feed server and FeedDO (cloud-api), and the oracle's daemon runs offline with no FeedDO; the local feed verbs are daemon commands, not resource-operations-v2 ops (the Unfreeze mutant only (Unfreeze = FALSE in every config here))
excluded.FeedHandoff:CloudAdopt: FeedDO commits the adopt or replays it from its ledger (cloud-api)
excluded.FeedHandoff:Lose: the handoff is between the daemon's local feed server and FeedDO (cloud-api), and the oracle's daemon runs offline with no FeedDO; the local feed verbs are daemon commands, not resource-operations-v2 ops (the network loses a message (channel state))
excluded.FeedHandoff:WaiterLocal: an agent's cmux feed watch reads the local owner and follows owner.moved (a daemon feed command)
excluded.FeedHandoff:WaiterCloud: the watch reads the answer at FeedDO (cloud-api)
excluded.hovercard:Hit: a hit test under the pointer (moved or not): pointer input, no product op

excluded.hovercard:Dismiss: Escape or a click dismisses the card: pointer and key input on the card, no product op
excluded.hovercard:Suppress: a drag or scroll starts (pointer input)
excluded.hovercard:Unsuppress: a drag or scroll ends (pointer input)
excluded.hovercard:Removed: HoverCardMachine.swift is app view state driven by the pointer, the timer and scroll or drag suppression; no resource-operations-v2 op, daemon state or app facet carries it, and driver_app.py has no pointer step (the target under the card leaves the view (a geometry change the machine observes))
excluded.hovercard:Pin: a click pins the card for t (pointer input)
